complexity_and_representation.two_sum: All use complement lookup before insertion. C and Rivet use open addressing; Rust uses standard HashMap. Expected O(n) search, not a worst-case linear guarantee. C capacity scales to input; Rivet has a fixed 32768-slot general map.
complexity_and_representation.add_two_numbers: All traverse real linked nodes with carry. C/Rust append owned output nodes with O(1) auxiliary state. Rivet conses a temporary reversed chain then reverses it into new output nodes, adding O(k) temporary storage. All perform O(m+n) work.
complexity_and_representation.median: All use binary partition search with O(log(min(m,n)+2)) iterations and O(1) search storage. C lower-bound search loads fewer elements per iteration; Rust uses guarded two-direction search; Rivet clamps valid partition range and loads four boundary values. Input parsing is separate.
